subtitle: Automation World semantic mapping console
externalIoDisabled: External I/O is disabled; Backend is unconfigured or has not been explicitly enabled.
smaHelpStartup: SMA is an independent desktop app that reads only SMA_* and its own configuration. Simulation and Mapping auto-start are off on first launch; startup preferences use an isolated directory.
smaHelpBoundary: Generic HTTP facts, API materials, targets, value rules, mapping preview and runtime diagnostics are retained. Existing Backend HTTP contracts still own configuration truth. New AW APIs, the business chain and SQLite configuration storage require separate tasks.
